mapper.select: SELECT pm.id, pm.project_id, pm.user_id, u.username, u.full_name, pm.project_role, pm.status, pm.joined_at, pm.created_at, pm.updated_at, pm.created_by, pm.updated_by, pm.active, u.role AS system_role, u.email, u.phone, u.tg_username, u.position AS user_position, u.department_id, d.name AS department_name FROM project_member pm LEFT JOIN user u ON pm.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN department d ON u.department_id = d.id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId}
